brief.objective: Create a premium responsive campaign banner for a field-kit collection with a clear first-glance message and one useful next action.
brief.audience: A time-poor outdoor customer scanning a campaign page on mobile or desktop.
brief.surface: Responsive campaign banner inside a marketing shell.
acceptance_criteria: Message, supporting context, and primary action scan in that order.
The subject has a deliberate focal point and remains identifiable at the smallest viewport.
The reference informs composition and crop without becoming copied layout or baked-in UI copy.
Desktop and mobile crops preserve the safe text zone, focal subject, readable copy, and reachable CTA.
The result is specific to an outdoor field-kit product rather than a generic template.

inputs.content: Northstar Field Kit banner; exact copy: Northstar Field Kit / Built for the next field note. / A considered kit for the miles between here and there. / Explore the field kit.

references.notes: Use the left negative space and right-side focal mass as evidence; do not copy the fixture text or geometry literally.
Use the restrained dusk palette as direction, not as a mandatory pixel palette.

must_include: One primary CTA with an explicit label
One focal subject or product cue
A text-safe zone distinct from the focal subject
An art-directed desktop crop and mobile crop
must_avoid: Fake discount, urgency, testimonial, or performance claims
Generic purple-blue gradient, purposeless glow, or decorative blob
Rasterized interface copy when HTML or SVG can carry it
technology: HTML/CSS or component implementation for copy and CTA
SVG or an appropriately sized raster asset for the visual subject
accessibility: Use semantic heading and button/link structure with visible focus.
Maintain readable contrast over the actual image crop and provide non-color action cues.
Support reduced motion and meaningful image alt/decorative treatment.
responsive: At 375px, recompose without losing headline, focal subject, safe zone, or CTA.
At 768px, avoid an awkward midpoint crop.
At 1440px, keep the composition anchored and text measure controlled.
constraints.notes: Product specificity: hiding the logo must still leave an outdoor field-kit visual through content, material, subject, and hierarchy. Performance: use responsive dimensions and do not ship an oversized hero. Edit when identity/composition are sound but crop, safe zone, contrast, or a local artifact needs correction; regenerate when subject, visual territory, or whole composition is structurally wrong. Stop at threshold, no material correction, budget exhaustion, tool block, or marginal improvement.

states.description: Full banner with supplied copy and primary CTA.
CTA hover treatment remains clear and restrained.
Keyboard focus is visible on the CTA.
Slow image loading does not destroy copy hierarchy or layout stability.
Motion is reduced without removing meaning or feedback.

expected_artifacts.role: crop safe-zone copy contrast subject and performance inspection
viewport and state visual regression ledger

immutable: Exact supplied copy and primary action meaning
high_sensitivity: Focal subject identity and material cues
flexible: Background texture, secondary details, crop strategy, and accessible type pairing
forbidden_inference: Do not invent price, stock, certification, customer proof, or product performance.
Do not treat the fixture as a logo or packaging identity.
